ISA address formation, compiler pointer semantics, relocation, translation, capability authority and microarchitectural address generation remain separately scoped.

notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation makes arithmetic width and address namespace explicit without prescribing an address-generation or MMU implementation.

evidence: Recomputed PC-relative 0x0200+0x30 as 0x0230 and pre/post-index old/new base values 0x1000/0x1010.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic Python snippet reproduced all five expected address-generation records.

evidence: Re-derived EA as width-bounded base plus scaled index plus reconstructed displacement.
Checked pre-index and post-index relations, precise-fault alternatives, translation/permission staging and relocation equivalence.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The symbolic structure is an addressing proof framework, not a complete memory-system or processor proof.

evidence: Reviewed zero/minimum/maximum displacements, negative indices, legal scales, wraparound, canonicality, PC bases, register overlap, every access size and alignment.
Reviewed page crossings, translation stages, permissions, segmentation, capability bounds/tags, relocation overflow, relaxation, speculation and silicon errata.

evidence: Reviewed fifteen operand, extension, arithmetic, PC-base, access, alignment, update, fault, translation, permission, capability, relocation, compiler, refinement and evidence obligations.

evidence: Audited uses of effective, virtual, physical, signed, aligned, canonical, precise, atomic, permitted and verified.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified progression from address expressions and namespaces through rich modes, memory-system boundaries and implementation evidence, followed by fifteen obligations, fifteen trade-offs, twenty-six misconceptions, ten examples and five complete exercises.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external computer-architecture academic, ISA maintainer, compiler or binary-tools engineer, OS/MMU or capability specialist, RTL or formal-verification engineer, security assessor, independent-verification or certification review is claimed.
